benefits.name: $200 Annual Travel Credit
benefits.description: Automatic statement credits totaling up to $200 each account anniversary year for purchases made directly from airlines, hotels, or car rental companies.
benefits.terms: Purchases must be made directly from airlines, hotels, or car rental companies. Credits apply to eligible Net Purchases that post each account anniversary year (account open date through the anniversary of the open date, and each 12 months thereafter). Maximum of $200 total per anniversary year.

benefits.name: 5% Korean Air Ticket Discount (x2)
benefits.description: Two 5% discount coupons on Korean Air tickets each year.
benefits.terms: Primary cardmember receives two 5% discount coupons in their SKYPASS account at account opening and each anniversary year. Valid one year from deposit. Applies to qualified Korean Air tickets on koreanair.com only; may not be applied to award tickets, upgrade awards, tickets which include other airline flights, or tickets already issued.

benefits.name: Korean Air Lounge Vouchers
benefits.description: Two complimentary Korean Air Lounge vouchers each year.
benefits.terms: Issued to the primary cardmember after account opening and each anniversary date after the annual fee is paid on time. Valid for 1 year from issue. Access limited to Korean Air lounges in Los Angeles, New York, Honolulu, and Incheon, Korea.

benefits.name: Priority Pass Select (4 Free Visits)
benefits.description: 12-month Priority Pass Select membership including four free lounge visits per membership year.

loungeAccessDetail.guestPolicy: Guests are permitted, but each guest counts as one of the four free member visits, or requires payment once free visits are used.

benefits.terms: Must enroll at prioritypass.com/skypassselect to receive a 12-month Priority Pass Select membership. Membership includes four free visits and unlimited paid visits for the year.

benefits.name: TSA PreCheck / Global Entry Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit of up to $120 for the TSA PreCheck or Global Entry application fee.
benefits.terms: Application fee must be paid with the card. The issuer page does not state how often this credit can be received; renewal cadence intentionally left unset until confirmed.

benefits.name: 5,000 Bonus Miles at $15,000 Annual Spend
benefits.description: 5,000 bonus miles after $15,000 in net purchases within each 12-month period from account opening.
benefits.terms: Awarded after a minimum of $15,000 in net purchases within the first 12 months of account opening and each 12 months thereafter.

benefits.name: 10,000 Bonus Miles at $35,000 Annual Spend
benefits.description: 10,000 annual renewal bonus miles after $35,000 in net purchases within each 12-month period from account opening.
benefits.terms: Awarded after a minimum of $35,000 in net purchases within the first 12 months of account opening and each 12 months thereafter.

benefits.name: Trip Cancellation / Interruption Reimbursement
benefits.description: Trip cancellation and trip interruption reimbursement coverage.
benefits.terms: Certain terms, conditions and exclusions apply; see the Visa Guide to Benefits for coverage details.

benefits.name: Trip Delay Reimbursement
benefits.terms: Certain terms, conditions and exclusions apply; see the Visa Guide to Benefits for coverage details.

benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Insurance coverage for car rentals made with the card.
benefits.terms: Certain terms, conditions and exclusions apply; see the Visa Guide to Benefits for coverage details.

earningRates.terms: Qualified Korean Air ticket purchases where Korean Air is the merchant of record, such as tickets purchased through Korean Air ticket agents or koreanair.com.
Eligible net purchases at airlines, hotels, car rental companies, restaurants, fast-food restaurants, or bars (including takeout and restaurant delivery).
